title: Vermont AI Laws

reading.body:
Vermont's only AI-related law governs synthetic media in elections, not AI development, data centers, or power.

The law requires a disclosure on deceptive synthetic media published within 90 days before an election in Vermont. It sets format requirements for images, video, and audio, provides penalties for knowing and intentional violations, and gives enforcement powers to the Attorney General and State's Attorneys. Candidates can seek injunctive relief. It passed on 2026-03-10.

This is a narrow instrument. It regulates a specific use of AI output in a specific window before a specific event, and it places its obligations on whoever publishes, communicates, or distributes the media. Nothing in it addresses model training, compute procurement, facility siting, or electricity supply, which are the layers that constrain AI scaling elsewhere.

The data covers one law and one state. It does not show how Vermont regulators treat AI in other domains, whether other bills were introduced and failed, or how this law compares with election-related AI statutes in other states. A single enacted law is a thin basis for characterizing Vermont's overall posture, and the page does not claim otherwise.

Vermont has enacted 1 AI-related law. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in Vermont

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • S0023: An act relating to the use of synthetic media in elections passed 2026-03-10

    This act requires a disclosure on synthetic media that is deceptive and fraudulent when published, communicated, or distributed within 90 days before an election in Vermont. It sets specific format requirements for the disclosure in images, video, and audio, and provides penalties for knowing and intentional violations. It also gives enforcement and investigation powers to the Attorney General and State's Attorneys, and allows candidates to seek injunctive relief.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Vermont. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
